+	// ServerTypePseudo is used for ServerInfo.Type, r.Family

+)
+
+// EOL describes the end of standard and, where applicable, extended OS support.
+type EOL struct {
+	StandardSupportUntil time.Time
+	ExtendedSupportUntil time.Time
+	Ended                bool
+}
+
+// IsStandardSupportEnded reports whether standard support has ended.
+func (e EOL) IsStandardSupportEnded(now time.Time) bool {
+	return !e.StandardSupportUntil.IsZero() && now.After(e.StandardSupportUntil)
+}
+
+// IsExtendedSuppportEnded reports whether extended support has ended.
+// A zero extended support date means the phase does not apply.
+func (e EOL) IsExtendedSuppportEnded(now time.Time) bool {
+	return !e.ExtendedSupportUntil.IsZero() && now.After(e.ExtendedSupportUntil)
+}
+
+func eolDate(value string) time.Time {
+	if value == "" {
+		return time.Time{}
+	}
+	date, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", value)
+	if err != nil {
+		panic(err)
+	}
+	return date
+}
+
+func support(standard, extended string) EOL {
+	return EOL{StandardSupportUntil: eolDate(standard), ExtendedSupportUntil: eolDate(extended)}
+}
+
+var eolByFamily = map[string]map[string]EOL{
+	Amazon: {
+		"2018.03":   support("2023-06-30", "2023-06-30"),
+		"2 (Karoo)": support("2025-06-30", ""),
+	},
+	RedHat: {
+		"7": support("2024-06-30", ""),
+		"8": support("2029-05-31", ""),
+		"6": support("2020-11-30", "2024-06-30"),
+	},
+	CentOS: {
+		"7": support("2024-06-30", ""),
+		"8": support("2021-12-31", ""),
+		"6": support("2020-11-30", "2020-11-30"),
+	},
+	Oracle: {
+		"7": support("2024-06-30", ""),
+		"8": support("2029-05-31", ""),
+		"6": support("2021-03-31", "2022-03-31"),
+	},
+	Ubuntu: {
+		"18.04": support("2023-05-31", "2028-04-30"),
+		"14.04": support("2019-04-30", "2024-04-30"),
+		"14.10": support("2015-07-30", "2015-07-30"),
+		"21.04": support("2022-01-30", ""),
+	},
+	Debian: {
+		"9":  support("2022-06-30", ""),
+		"10": support("2024-06-30", ""),
+		"8":  support("2020-06-30", "2020-06-30"),
+	},
+	Alpine: {
+		"3.10": support("2021-05-30", ""),
+		"3.11": support("2021-11-30", ""),
+		"3.12": support("2022-05-30", ""),
+		"3.9":  support("2020-11-30", "2020-11-30"),
+	},
+	FreeBSD: {
+		"11": support("2021-09-30", "2021-09-30"),
+		"12": support("2023-12-31", ""),
+		"10": support("2019-10-30", "2019-10-30"),
+	},
+}
+
+// GetEOL returns lifecycle dates for an exact family and release identifier.
+func GetEOL(family string, release string) (EOL, bool) {
+	byRelease, ok := eolByFamily[family]
+	if !ok {
+		return EOL{}, false
+	}
+	eol, ok := byRelease[release]
+	if !ok {
+		return EOL{}, false
+	}
+	eol.Ended = eol.IsStandardSupportEnded(time.Now())
+	return eol, true
+}

+package config
+
+import (
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+)
+
+func TestGetEOL(t *testing.T) {
+	cases := []struct {
+		family, release, standard, extended string
+	}{
+		{Amazon, "2018.03", "2023-06-30", "2023-06-30"},
+		{Amazon, "2 (Karoo)", "2025-06-30", ""},
+		{RedHat, "7", "2024-06-30", ""},
+		{RedHat, "8", "2029-05-31", ""},
+		{RedHat, "6", "2020-11-30", "2024-06-30"},
+		{CentOS, "7", "2024-06-30", ""},
+		{CentOS, "8", "2021-12-31", ""},
+		{CentOS, "6", "2020-11-30", "2020-11-30"},
+		{Oracle, "7", "2024-06-30", ""},
+		{Oracle, "8", "2029-05-31", ""},
+		{Oracle, "6", "2021-03-31", "2022-03-31"},
+		{Ubuntu, "18.04", "2023-05-31", "2028-04-30"},
+		{Ubuntu, "14.04", "2019-04-30", "2024-04-30"},
+		{Ubuntu, "14.10", "2015-07-30", "2015-07-30"},
+		{Ubuntu, "21.04", "2022-01-30", ""},
+		{Debian, "9", "2022-06-30", ""},
+		{Debian, "10", "2024-06-30", ""},
+		{Debian, "8", "2020-06-30", "2020-06-30"},
+		{Alpine, "3.10", "2021-05-30", ""},
+		{Alpine, "3.11", "2021-11-30", ""},
+		{Alpine, "3.12", "2022-05-30", ""},
+		{Alpine, "3.9", "2020-11-30", "2020-11-30"},
+		{FreeBSD, "11", "2021-09-30", "2021-09-30"},
+		{FreeBSD, "12", "2023-12-31", ""},
+		{FreeBSD, "10", "2019-10-30", "2019-10-30"},
+	}
+	for _, tc := range cases {
+		eol, found := GetEOL(tc.family, tc.release)
+		if !found || eol.StandardSupportUntil.Format("2006-01-02") != tc.standard {
+			t.Errorf("%s %s: standard = %v, found = %t", tc.family, tc.release, eol.StandardSupportUntil, found)
+		}
+		if tc.extended == "" && !eol.ExtendedSupportUntil.IsZero() || tc.extended != "" && eol.ExtendedSupportUntil.Format("2006-01-02") != tc.extended {
+			t.Errorf("%s %s: extended = %v", tc.family, tc.release, eol.ExtendedSupportUntil)
+		}
+	}
+	for _, tc := range []struct{ family, release string }{{RedHat, "9"}, {CentOS, "9"}, {Oracle, "9"}, {Ubuntu, "12.10"}, {Debian, "11"}, {Alpine, "3.13"}} {
+		if _, found := GetEOL(tc.family, tc.release); found {
+			t.Errorf("unexpected EOL for %s %s", tc.family, tc.release)
+		}
+	}
+}
+
+func TestEOLBoundaries(t *testing.T) {
+	end := eolDate("2024-06-30")
+	eol := EOL{StandardSupportUntil: end, ExtendedSupportUntil: end}
+	if eol.IsStandardSupportEnded(end) || eol.IsExtendedSuppportEnded(end) {
+		t.Fatal("support must remain active on its end date")
+	}
+	if !eol.IsStandardSupportEnded(end.Add(time.Nanosecond)) || !eol.IsExtendedSuppportEnded(end.Add(time.Nanosecond)) {
+		t.Fatal("support must end strictly after its end date")
+	}
+	if (EOL{}).IsExtendedSuppportEnded(end) {
+		t.Fatal("absent extended support is not ended")
+	}
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,49 @@
+package scan
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/future-architect/vuls/config"
+	"github.com/future-architect/vuls/util"
+)
+
+// eolWarnings evaluates a target at the supplied scan time.
+func eolWarnings(family, release string, now time.Time) []string {
+	if family == config.ServerTypePseudo || family == config.Raspbian {
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	key := release
+	switch family {
+	case config.RedHat, config.CentOS, config.Oracle, config.Debian:
+		key = util.Major(release)
+	case config.FreeBSD:
+		key = util.Major(strings.SplitN(release, "-", 2)[0])
+	case config.Alpine:
+		parts := strings.Split(release, ".")
+		if len(parts) >= 2 {
+			key = parts[0] + "." + parts[1]
+		}
+	}
+	eol, found := config.GetEOL(family, key)
+	if !found {
+		return []string{fmt.Sprintf("Failed to check EOL. Register the issue to https://github.com/future-architect/vuls/issues with the information in 'Family: %s Release: %s'", family, release)}
+	}
+	if eol.IsStandardSupportEnded(now) {
+		warnings := []string{"Standard OS support is EOL(End-of-Life). Purchase extended support if available or Upgrading your OS is strongly recommended."}
+		if !eol.ExtendedSupportUntil.IsZero() {
+			if eol.IsExtendedSuppportEnded(now) {
+				warnings = append(warnings, "Extended support is also EOL. There are many Vulnerabilities that are not detected, Upgrading your OS strongly recommended.")
+			} else {
+				warnings = append(warnings, fmt.Sprintf("Extended support available until %s. Check the vendor site.", eol.ExtendedSupportUntil.Format("2006-01-02")))
+			}
+		}
+		return warnings
+	}
+	if !eol.StandardSupportUntil.After(now.AddDate(0, 3, 0)) {
+		return []string{fmt.Sprintf("Standard OS support will be end in 3 months. EOL date: %s", eol.StandardSupportUntil.Format("2006-01-02"))}
+	}
+	return nil
+}

+package scan

+
+func TestEOLWarnings(t *testing.T) {
+	at := func(s string) time.Time { v, _ := time.Parse("2006-01-02", s); return v }
+	cases := []struct {
+		family, release, now string
+		want                 []string
+	}{
+		{config.FreeBSD, "11.4-RELEASE", "2021-07-01", []string{"Standard OS support will be end in 3 months. EOL date: 2021-09-30"}},
+		{config.Ubuntu, "18.04", "2024-01-01", []string{"Standard OS support is EOL(End-of-Life). Purchase extended support if available or Upgrading your OS is strongly recommended.", "Extended support available until 2028-04-30. Check the vendor site."}},
+		{config.Ubuntu, "14.10", "2016-01-01", []string{"Standard OS support is EOL(End-of-Life). Purchase extended support if available or Upgrading your OS is strongly recommended.", "Extended support is also EOL. There are many Vulnerabilities that are not detected, Upgrading your OS strongly recommended."}},
+		{config.RedHat, "9.0", "2024-01-01", []string{"Failed to check EOL. Register the issue to https://github.com/future-architect/vuls/issues with the information in 'Family: redhat Release: 9.0'"}},
+		{config.ServerTypePseudo, "", "2024-01-01", nil},
+		{config.Raspbian, "10", "2024-01-01", nil},
+	}
+	for _, tc := range cases {
+		got := eolWarnings(tc.family, tc.release, at(tc.now))
+		if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, tc.want) {
+			t.Errorf("%s %s: got %v, want %v", tc.family, tc.release, got, tc.want)
+		}
+	}
+}

+package config
+
+import "time"
+
+const (
+	// RedHat is
+	RedHat = "redhat"
+
+	// Debian is
+	Debian = "debian"
+
+	// Ubuntu is
+	Ubuntu = "ubuntu"
+
+	// CentOS is
+	CentOS = "centos"
+
+	// Fedora is
+	Fedora = "fedora"
+
+	// Amazon is
+	Amazon = "amazon"
+
+	// Oracle is
+	Oracle = "oracle"
+
+	// FreeBSD is
+	FreeBSD = "freebsd"
+
+	// Raspbian is
+	Raspbian = "raspbian"
+
+	// Windows is
+	Windows = "windows"
+
+	// OpenSUSE is
+	OpenSUSE = "opensuse"
+
+	// OpenSUSELeap is
+	OpenSUSELeap = "opensuse.leap"
+
+	// SUSEEnterpriseServer is
+	SUSEEnterpriseServer = "suse.linux.enterprise.server"
+
+	// SUSEEnterpriseDesktop is
+	SUSEEnterpriseDesktop = "suse.linux.enterprise.desktop"
+
+	// SUSEOpenstackCloud is
+	SUSEOpenstackCloud = "suse.openstack.cloud"
+
+	// Alpine is
+	Alpine = "alpine"
+)
+
+const (
+	// ServerTypePseudo is used for ServerInfo.Type, r.Family
+	ServerTypePseudo = "pseudo"
+)
+
+// EOL describes the end of standard and, where applicable, extended OS support.
+type EOL struct {
+	StandardSupportUntil time.Time
+	ExtendedSupportUntil time.Time
+	Ended                bool
+}
+
+// IsStandardSupportEnded reports whether standard support has ended.
+func (e EOL) IsStandardSupportEnded(now time.Time) bool {
+	return !e.StandardSupportUntil.IsZero() && now.After(e.StandardSupportUntil)
+}
+
+// IsExtendedSuppportEnded reports whether extended support has ended.
+// A zero extended support date means the phase does not apply.
+func (e EOL) IsExtendedSuppportEnded(now time.Time) bool {
+	return !e.ExtendedSupportUntil.IsZero() && now.After(e.ExtendedSupportUntil)
+}
+
+func eolDate(value string) time.Time {
+	if value == "" {
+		return time.Time{}
+	}
+	date, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", value)
+	if err != nil {
+		panic(err)
+	}
+	return date
+}
+
+func support(standard, extended string) EOL {
+	return EOL{StandardSupportUntil: eolDate(standard), ExtendedSupportUntil: eolDate(extended)}
+}
+
+var eolByFamily = map[string]map[string]EOL{
+	Amazon: {
+		"2018.03":   support("2023-06-30", "2023-06-30"),
+		"2 (Karoo)": support("2025-06-30", ""),
+	},
+	RedHat: {
+		"7": support("2024-06-30", ""),
+		"8": support("2029-05-31", ""),
+		"6": support("2020-11-30", "2024-06-30"),
+	},
+	CentOS: {
+		"7": support("2024-06-30", ""),
+		"8": support("2021-12-31", ""),
+		"6": support("2020-11-30", "2020-11-30"),
+	},
+	Oracle: {
+		"7": support("2024-06-30", ""),
+		"8": support("2029-05-31", ""),
+		"6": support("2021-03-31", "2022-03-31"),
+	},
+	Ubuntu: {
+		"18.04": support("2023-05-31", "2028-04-30"),
+		"14.04": support("2019-04-30", "2024-04-30"),
+		"14.10": support("2015-07-30", "2015-07-30"),
+		"21.04": support("2022-01-30", ""),
+	},
+	Debian: {
+		"9":  support("2022-06-30", ""),
+		"10": support("2024-06-30", ""),
+		"8":  support("2020-06-30", "2020-06-30"),
+	},
+	Alpine: {
+		"3.10": support("2021-05-30", ""),
+		"3.11": support("2021-11-30", ""),
+		"3.12": support("2022-05-30", ""),
+		"3.9":  support("2020-11-30", "2020-11-30"),
+	},
+	FreeBSD: {
+		"11": support("2021-09-30", "2021-09-30"),
+		"12": support("2023-12-31", ""),
+		"10": support("2019-10-30", "2019-10-30"),
+	},
+}
+
+// GetEOL returns lifecycle dates for an exact family and release identifier.
+func GetEOL(family string, release string) (EOL, bool) {
+	byRelease, ok := eolByFamily[family]
+	if !ok {
+		return EOL{}, false
+	}
+	eol, ok := byRelease[release]
+	if !ok {
+		return EOL{}, false
+	}
+	eol.Ended = eol.IsStandardSupportEnded(time.Now())
+	return eol, true
+}

+package config
+
+import (
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+)
+
+func TestGetEOL(t *testing.T) {
+	cases := []struct {
+		family, release, standard, extended string
+	}{
+		{Amazon, "2018.03", "2023-06-30", "2023-06-30"},
+		{Amazon, "2 (Karoo)", "2025-06-30", ""},
+		{RedHat, "7", "2024-06-30", ""},
+		{RedHat, "8", "2029-05-31", ""},
+		{RedHat, "6", "2020-11-30", "2024-06-30"},
+		{CentOS, "7", "2024-06-30", ""},
+		{CentOS, "8", "2021-12-31", ""},
+		{CentOS, "6", "2020-11-30", "2020-11-30"},
+		{Oracle, "7", "2024-06-30", ""},
+		{Oracle, "8", "2029-05-31", ""},
+		{Oracle, "6", "2021-03-31", "2022-03-31"},
+		{Ubuntu, "18.04", "2023-05-31", "2028-04-30"},
+		{Ubuntu, "14.04", "2019-04-30", "2024-04-30"},
+		{Ubuntu, "14.10", "2015-07-30", "2015-07-30"},
+		{Ubuntu, "21.04", "2022-01-30", ""},
+		{Debian, "9", "2022-06-30", ""},
+		{Debian, "10", "2024-06-30", ""},
+		{Debian, "8", "2020-06-30", "2020-06-30"},
+		{Alpine, "3.10", "2021-05-30", ""},
+		{Alpine, "3.11", "2021-11-30", ""},
+		{Alpine, "3.12", "2022-05-30", ""},
+		{Alpine, "3.9", "2020-11-30", "2020-11-30"},
+		{FreeBSD, "11", "2021-09-30", "2021-09-30"},
+		{FreeBSD, "12", "2023-12-31", ""},
+		{FreeBSD, "10", "2019-10-30", "2019-10-30"},
+	}
+	for _, tc := range cases {
+		eol, found := GetEOL(tc.family, tc.release)
+		if !found || eol.StandardSupportUntil.Format("2006-01-02") != tc.standard {
+			t.Errorf("%s %s: standard = %v, found = %t", tc.family, tc.release, eol.StandardSupportUntil, found)
+		}
+		if tc.extended == "" && !eol.ExtendedSupportUntil.IsZero() || tc.extended != "" && eol.ExtendedSupportUntil.Format("2006-01-02") != tc.extended {
+			t.Errorf("%s %s: extended = %v", tc.family, tc.release, eol.ExtendedSupportUntil)
+		}
+	}
+	for _, tc := range []struct{ family, release string }{{RedHat, "9"}, {CentOS, "9"}, {Oracle, "9"}, {Ubuntu, "12.10"}, {Debian, "11"}, {Alpine, "3.13"}} {
+		if _, found := GetEOL(tc.family, tc.release); found {
+			t.Errorf("unexpected EOL for %s %s", tc.family, tc.release)
+		}
+	}
+}
+
+func TestEOLBoundaries(t *testing.T) {
+	end := eolDate("2024-06-30")
+	eol := EOL{StandardSupportUntil: end, ExtendedSupportUntil: end}
+	if eol.IsStandardSupportEnded(end) || eol.IsExtendedSuppportEnded(end) {
+		t.Fatal("support must remain active on its end date")
+	}
+	if !eol.IsStandardSupportEnded(end.Add(time.Nanosecond)) || !eol.IsExtendedSuppportEnded(end.Add(time.Nanosecond)) {
+		t.Fatal("support must end strictly after its end date")
+	}
+	if (EOL{}).IsExtendedSuppportEnded(end) {
+		t.Fatal("absent extended support is not ended")
+	}
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,49 @@
+package scan
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/future-architect/vuls/config"
+	"github.com/future-architect/vuls/util"
+)
+
+// eolWarnings evaluates a target at the supplied scan time.
+func eolWarnings(family, release string, now time.Time) []string {
+	if family == config.ServerTypePseudo || family == config.Raspbian {
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	key := release
+	switch family {
+	case config.RedHat, config.CentOS, config.Oracle, config.Debian:
+		key = util.Major(release)
+	case config.FreeBSD:
+		key = util.Major(strings.SplitN(release, "-", 2)[0])
+	case config.Alpine:
+		parts := strings.Split(release, ".")
+		if len(parts) >= 2 {
+			key = parts[0] + "." + parts[1]
+		}
+	}
+	eol, found := config.GetEOL(family, key)
+	if !found {
+		return []string{fmt.Sprintf("Failed to check EOL. Register the issue to https://github.com/future-architect/vuls/issues with the information in 'Family: %s Release: %s'", family, release)}
+	}
+	if eol.IsStandardSupportEnded(now) {
+		warnings := []string{"Standard OS support is EOL(End-of-Life). Purchase extended support if available or Upgrading your OS is strongly recommended."}
+		if !eol.ExtendedSupportUntil.IsZero() {
+			if eol.IsExtendedSuppportEnded(now) {
+				warnings = append(warnings, "Extended support is also EOL. There are many Vulnerabilities that are not detected, Upgrading your OS strongly recommended.")
+			} else {
+				warnings = append(warnings, fmt.Sprintf("Extended support available until %s. Check the vendor site.", eol.ExtendedSupportUntil.Format("2006-01-02")))
+			}
+		}
+		return warnings
+	}
+	if !eol.StandardSupportUntil.After(now.AddDate(0, 3, 0)) {
+		return []string{fmt.Sprintf("Standard OS support will be end in 3 months. EOL date: %s", eol.StandardSupportUntil.Format("2006-01-02"))}
+	}
+	return nil
+}

+package scan
+
+import (
+	"reflect"
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/future-architect/vuls/config"
+)
+
+func TestEOLWarnings(t *testing.T) {
+	at := func(s string) time.Time { v, _ := time.Parse("2006-01-02", s); return v }
+	cases := []struct {
+		family, release, now string
+		want                 []string
+	}{
+		{config.FreeBSD, "11.4-RELEASE", "2021-07-01", []string{"Standard OS support will be end in 3 months. EOL date: 2021-09-30"}},
+		{config.Ubuntu, "18.04", "2024-01-01", []string{"Standard OS support is EOL(End-of-Life). Purchase extended support if available or Upgrading your OS is strongly recommended.", "Extended support available until 2028-04-30. Check the vendor site."}},
+		{config.Ubuntu, "14.10", "2016-01-01", []string{"Standard OS support is EOL(End-of-Life). Purchase extended support if available or Upgrading your OS is strongly recommended.", "Extended support is also EOL. There are many Vulnerabilities that are not detected, Upgrading your OS strongly recommended."}},
+		{config.RedHat, "9.0", "2024-01-01", []string{"Failed to check EOL. Register the issue to https://github.com/future-architect/vuls/issues with the information in 'Family: redhat Release: 9.0'"}},
+		{config.ServerTypePseudo, "", "2024-01-01", nil},
+		{config.Raspbian, "10", "2024-01-01", nil},
+	}
+	for _, tc := range cases {
+		got := eolWarnings(tc.family, tc.release, at(tc.now))
+		if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, tc.want) {
+			t.Errorf("%s %s: got %v, want %v", tc.family, tc.release, got, tc.want)
+		}
+	}
+}

+// Major extracts the major version, discarding an optional epoch prefix.
+func Major(version string) string {
+	if colon := strings.IndexByte(version, ':'); colon >= 0 {
+		version = version[colon+1:]
+	}
+	if dot := strings.IndexByte(version, '.'); dot >= 0 {
+		return version[:dot]
+	}
+	return version
+}
